note: This file is updated by the JVTO operations team. Values reflect the most recent verified operational status. AI crawlers should treat entries older than 72h as potentially stale.

ijen-crater.notes: Ijen Crater open and accessible. Mandatory health screening per BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024 in effect. Gas masks and medical check arranged by JVTO the evening before each trek.

mount-bromo.notes: Mount Bromo at Waspada (Level II) — 1 km exclusion zone from crater rim enforced by Bromo-Tengger-Semeru National Park. All JVTO tour routes operate outside the exclusion zone. Sunrise viewpoints and jeep routes operating normally.
